name: params-large-integer-roundtrip
description: A 64-bit integer beyond 2^53-1 passed via params round-trips through INSERT/SELECT unchanged, exactly like the BLOB round-trip in query-roundtrip.json (protocol.md's round-trip symmetry, testing.md's explicit large-integer round-trip check). Was broken in v0.1.0 (params numbers decoded through float64, silently corrupting the value and changing the stored SQLite column type from INTEGER to REAL); fixed in v0.1.1 via json.Decoder.UseNumber(), per https://github.com/amisonnet8/san-db-ox/issues/1. Re-verified independently against the v0.1.1 release binary before removing known_failing.
